flight_intro.caption: 5 December. Krampusnacht. Somewhere over the Alps.

flight_intro.text: Nick, the elves sent to St. Wendel's never came home. The whole village has gone dark. Not a candle, not a bell.
It's the fifth of December. You know whose night this is.

choice.text: I know. I'll bring them home, Holly.

then.text: Bring yourself home as well. In one piece, please.

choice.text: If it's him, this ends tonight.

then.text: Four hundred years and you still can't say his name.

choice.text: Maybe he's just put up some very dark decorations.

then.text: Elves in sacks, Nick. That isn't tinsel.

flight_intro.text: Follow the valley. Steer with A and D or the mouse, W and S for speed, Shift to boost. The sleigh keeps to the road on its own.

flight_rings.text: Those lights in the sky are beacons. Fly through them and the reindeer get their second wind.

sack_wriggle.text: ...Holly, did you pack anything alive in the toy sack?

pepper.text: Ta-da! Don't turn round, keep your eyes on the mountains!
Pepper! You're supposed to be at the workshop.
You need a navigator. And I need someone to take me seriously!
Also it was very cramped in there and somebody packed a xylophone.

village_dark.text: There it is. St. Wendel's. Santa, there isn't a single light on.

landed.text: Something's moving up the street. Lots of somethings. With horns.
His helpers. Stay with the sleigh, Pepper.
Absolutely not. Punch with the left mouse button! And right-click or R to block. Time it as they swing and they'll fall right over!

first_beaten.text: Poof! Do they all go poof? I hope they all go poof.

first_parry.text: Ooh, you blocked that! Do that again! Do that every time!

arrival.caption: The church square. Six sacks hang from the bell tower, and every one of them is wriggling.

arrival.text: Hello, Nick. Four hundred years and you still dress like a postbox.

arrival.caption: Two figures in the snow: one red, one horned. The red one points down the mountain, and the horned one goes.

choice.text: Hello, old friend. Let them down.

then.text: Old friend. You did hear yourself say that, didn't you?
Still giving orders. Some of us stopped taking them a long time ago.

choice.text: And you still smell like a wet stable.

then.text: Ha! I've missed that. I've missed nothing else, but I've missed that.

arrival.text: Tonight is my night, Nick. My List. My village. My little sacks of elves.
Boys! Take them over the bridge.
They're cutting the sacks down! Stop them before they reach the bridge, then press E to untie a sack!

first_drop.text: It dropped one! Quick, E to untie it!

freed_1.text: You're out! Go, go, run to the church! The bell ropes are inside!

freed_2.text: Another one! They're heading for the bells. Keep them coming!

freed_3.text: That's enough hands for the bell ropes now. Every one you save makes it ring louder!

lost_1.text: No! One got over the bridge! Don't let them reach the west end of the square!

lost_2.text: That's two gone, Santa. We can't lose another one!

taunt_1.text: Faster, Nick! You used to be faster. You used to be a lot of things.

taunt_2.text: Every sack over that bridge is one more name off your precious List.

boss_intro.text: Enough. Hear that, Nick? Silence. Nobody here believes in you any more.
In the dark, I don't bruise. Come and find out.
Santa, the elves are at the bell ropes! Get to the church door and press E. Make some noise!

parry_hint.text: He's winding up that chain! Block just as it comes down: right-click or R!

dark_punch.text: Is that it? It's dark, Nick. I can't feel a thing in the dark.

dark_punch_2.text: It's not working! The bells, Santa! Ring the bells!

dark_parry.text: Nice block. Doesn't matter. Not in the dark.

tickles.text: That tickles. Is that what four hundred years of milk and cookies does to a man?

caught_hint.text: You've got his chain! Hit him NOW!

countered.text: Swing, swing, swing. You always did fight like a toddler with a stick.
Don't just flail at him! Block the chain first, then hit!

yanked.text: Too slow! Hit him while you've still got hold of the chain!

bells.text: No! Not the bells! I hate the bells!
The lights are coming on! He's flinching! Now he can be hurt!

phase_1.text: Oof! Lucky. You were always lucky.

lights_out.text: Who needs light? I like the dark. The dark likes me.
He's put the lights out! Back to the church door, ring them again!

phase_2.text: ENOUGH! Two chains, Nick! Let's see you catch both!
He's lashing twice now! Block, then block again!

outro.caption: Krampus lies in the snow. The bells are still ringing.

outro.text: Go on, then. Finish it. You've been wanting to since 1620.

choice.text: No. I'm not banishing anyone tonight.
Get up. I want answers, not a trophy.

then.text: Answers. From me. Well, that's new.

choice.text: And ruin my coat? Not likely.

outro.text: I'm a goat, Nick. I don't even have a phone.

outro.caption: And he's gone, up over the rooftops and away into the mountains.

outro.text: Santa? Come and look at this. On the sack ropes.
Hair. Coarse and dark, all tangled into the knots. Goat hair, I think.
...Keep it, Pepper. Put it somewhere safe.
Does this mean I'm the navigator now?
It means you're the navigator now.
